The gift inside the gift

A letter from the author, for the human being you love.

Santa says: Santa can’t write to everyone. So he asked the author.

Buy a printed copy for someone you love, tell us a little about them, and Cristina will write them a personal letter, signed, ready to slip inside the book.

Santa only hosts this page. The letter is written by Cristina Liliana Calin, from the first line to the signature.

Sample letter

Dear Maria,

Andrei told me a few things about you. He was careful. He said you would be annoyed if he told me too much, and then he told me quite a lot.

He says your status report this year said “everything is on track”. He also says you carried a team nobody saw, and that you did it in the same calm voice you use when the coffee machine breaks. He noticed. He wanted you to know that he noticed.

So here is a book. It is about a woman who promises Friday on a Monday morning, then spends the week finding out what that promise really costs. You may recognize a meeting or two. Please read it somewhere warm, with your phone in another room. The team chat will survive one evening without you. I checked.

One more thing from Andrei, because he asked me to put it in writing: you are the reason the people around you feel steady. That is not on any status report. It should be.

Merry Christmas, Maria.

Cristina Liliana Calin

Signature placeholder: the real letter carries Cristina’s handwritten signature.

How it works

Three steps. One of them is wrapping.

You are here because someone crossed your mind. That is already the best part of the gift. The rest is three small steps, and Santa promises none of them involves a ladder.

  1. 1

    Buy a printed copy

    On Amazon, paperback or hardcover. Both fit nicely under a tree, and neither needs batteries.

    Find it on Amazon (opens in a new tab)
  2. 2

    Answer a 2-minute quiz

    A few taps about the human being who gets the book, and one line in your own words. Two minutes. Shorter than untangling the Christmas lights.

    Start the quiz
  3. 3

    Then you do nothing

    Within 48 hours, a PDF arrives by email: the personal letter and the “Christmas Eve Edition 2026” card, ready to print and slip into the book, plus a thank-you note for you. Cristina writes, we send, you print, they smile.

  • We go on trust: no proof of purchase, just tell us which book.
  • No limit on letters. One per book you give.
  • Nothing is sent by post. You print it at home.

The quiz

Nothing that would embarrass anyone. Probably.

From Iceland

Santa’s favorite tradition

It is called Jólabókaflóð, the Christmas book flood. Books are given on Christmas Eve, and read that same night.

Santa approves. Nobody has ever had to restart a book.
